marc:datafield.marc:subfield: "This program uses succinct and dynamic graphics to demonstrate the operation of semiconductors, diodes and transistors, and explains how the invention of the integrated circuit and transistor has revolutionised electronic. Viewers will learn about N-type and P-type semiconductors and the major feature of each, such as charge carriers and holes. They will see PN diodes and NPN transistors and find out how they work in terms of their semiconductor structure. Finally viewers will come to understand just how widespread the use of semiconductors is in our modern electronic society; from computer chips, to LED lights and solar cells. "-- Container.
